intro: Honduras was home to the Maya city of Copán and later became known as a 'banana republic'.

chapters.title: Copán
text: The Maya city of Copán is famous for its carved stelae and the Hieroglyphic Stairway, the longest known Maya text.

chapters.title: Conquest and independence
text: Columbus reached the coast in 1502. Lempira, an Indigenous leader, resisted the Spanish and is now a national hero; the currency is named after him. Honduras became independent in 1821.

highlight.title: Lempira
highlight.text: The currency and a department are named after this resistance leader.

chapters.title: Bananas and politics
text: In the early 1900s US fruit companies controlled much of the land and politics, giving rise to the phrase 'banana republic'. Hurricane Mitch in 1998 killed thousands. A coup removed the president in 2009.

timeline.title: Football War
timeline.text: A short war with El Salvador.

keyTerms.meaning: A country controlled by foreign companies.
